title: One client-safe screen-wave contract: typed codes, guarded result, reason-aware 409s
tests_added: app/features/hiring/decisions/decisionsScreenWaveMachine.test.ts (7 new cases; 4 existing commitConflict cases re-pointed to commitRefused mismatch)
deviations_from_card: (1) Write set grew by 3 files, all mechanical fallout: app/features/shell/simulation/SimDecisionWave.tsx (a 1-line null-reasonCode guard; the new contract turned it into a type error, which is the point of the card), and two source-guard tests that pinned the old expressions: decisionsWaveSeal.test.ts (WaveResult = { ... sealFailures } is now an alias; it now pins the alias and the contract's required sealFailures) and decisionsWaveKeepKind.test.ts (regex over screen-wave.ts's union is now a comparison against the runtime SCREEN_REASON_CODES, and it forbids a redeclared union). (2) perf-budget.json (a shared surface, taken under the lock): app/page.tsx 1377/8741 -> 1378/8754, which is this card's measured share only (+1 module / +13 KB on committed main + this card alone). (3) Commit series is refactor(server contract + its tests) then feat(client + its tests), not a test-only commit first, so that every commit is green. (4) The spent-refusal reload is called directly from the hook via REFUSAL_EFFECT[reason].landedElsewhere, not from a useEffect, which avoids a new eslint-disable. The machine still carries landedElsewhere, consumed on previewSettled, as case 7 specifies. (5) No messages/* change: the blocked line reuses the errors.SCREEN_WAVE_APPROVAL_UNATTRIBUTED sentence already resolved by errMsg, and the sim walk's malformed-body failure uses errors.SCREEN_WAVE_FAILED.
notes: Slot B hooks: add a code to SCREEN_REASON_CODES (e.g. recruiterSpared) in app/_lib/screen-wave-contract.ts. The contract test then requires decisions.wave.reasons.<code> in en.json, and decisionsWaveKeepKind.test.ts's ALL list must gain it. A new machine event goes in WaveEvent, and waveReduce's exhaustive switch will flag it. REFUSAL_EFFECT is a total Record<ScreenWaveRefusalReason, ...>. readWaveResult ignores unknown body fields, so a new optional decision field must be added to readDecision explicitly. tsc exits 2 only on the untracked kpi-sim/ tree (foreign, present at session start); my paths are clean. At the time of the full test:unit run, 5 files were red and none are this card's: job-workspace-state-tenancy, tenancy-coverage x2, route-tenancy-coverage, workspaces-route (a sibling's in-flight job_workspace_state work) and python-runner-concurrency (environment). At the time of the test:perf run, the line overages (analyze route, several routes' KB, jds/generate, tasks/retry, llm-config, job-ingest) were all measured absent on HEAD + this card alone. page.tsx is at 1378/8751 against the new 1378/8754 with the siblings' uncommitted work included.
